outcome: Need for mechanical ventilation (MV) within 72 hours
First-pass success rate in endotracheal tube or LISA catheter placement
cohort: The study included 108 infants born before 28 weeks gestational age (median 26 weeks GA) who received either less invasive surfactant administration (LISA) or intubation-surfactant-extubation (INSURE).
finding: Less invasive surfactant administration (LISA) was associated with a lower need for mechanical ventilation within 72 hours and during admission compared to intubation-surfactant-extubation (INSURE).
followup_time: During admission (including within 72 hours after birth)
gest_age: Infants born before 28 weeks gestational age (median 26 weeks GA)
